overall: The AG found no violation in the Friday 2:00 p.m. scheduling, declined to review the public comment, chair, and tabling allegations as not Open Meeting Law issues, and declined two untimely complaints.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board did not allow public comment on appointments at the August 22 meeting, contrary to a Board comment policy.
allegations.key_passage: The Open Meeting Law does not require that a public body allow for public participation at its meetings.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the chair refused a member's request to discuss appointments in more detail during the August 22 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Thus, the Open Meeting Law gives discretion to the chair of a public body to determine who may speak or otherwise participate at a meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged discussion of appointments had been tabled and delayed several times since June.
allegations.key_passage: Finally, the law does not require a public body to discuss any particular matter or discuss a matter in any particular depth, nor does the law prohibit a public body from removing, postponing, declining, or tabling the discussion of a topic that is listed on a meeting notice.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board intentionally scheduled the August 22 meeting for a Friday at 2:00 p.m. to avoid public comment on appointments.
allegations.key_passage: no evidence has been presented to support this assertion or otherwise support a finding that the Board scheduled the August 22 meeting with the intent of discouraging public attendance at the meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint noted the Board rescheduled its August 25 meeting to August 22; the letter found no clearly raised allegation about the rescheduling.
allegations.key_passage: Rescheduling a meeting, in and of itself, does not violate the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainant sought review of two additional complaints filed September 16 that the Board had not received on a timely basis.
allegations.key_passage: we declined review of these complaints because they were not timely filed with the Board.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
